columns.name: WA_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a WhatsApp template in Recruiting. Foreign key, references WA_TEMPLATE_ID column in irc_whatsapp_template_b

columns.name: TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE
columns.description: Indicates the oracle code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: WABA_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Unique ID generated by Meta upon creating the WhatsApp template

columns.name: WABA_TEMPLATE_STATUS
columns.description: The current status of the WhatsApp template as in Meta. Possible values include ORA_DRAFT, ORA_APPROVED, ORA_REJECTED, ORA_PENDING_APPROVAL, ORA_SUSPENDED, ORA_INACTIVE

columns.name: REJECTION_REASON
columns.description: Explanation for why Meta rejected the WhatsApp template

columns.name: DECISION_DATE
columns.description: Timestamp of Meta's latest decision regarding the WhatsApp template

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
